## Mike McClone
### Title
Graphic Designer
**Mike McClone** is a Mattel employee who has worked at Mattel since 2000. He specializes in graphics design and has worked on a variety of castings since 2000, usually working alongside Jerry Thienprasiddhi .
Signed Graphics E-sheet M. McClone & Riehlman
